messages.label: User
messages.text: My home Wi-Fi is completely down! None of my devices can get online and I need to work. Please help me fix it!

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Sure, let's get your Wi-Fi up and running. First, can you check if your router is on? If it's not, turn it on and see if that helps.

messages.label: check_device_indicator_light
User
messages.text:
A blinking orange light on the router usually means it's having trouble connecting to the internet. Let's check the modem, which is the device that brings the internet into your home.

Could you please look at the lights on your modem and tell me what they are doing?

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Sure, I'll check the modem lights.

messages.label: User
messages.text: Okay, I'm looking at the modem. There are a few lights... one is a solid green light that looks like a little globe.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: A solid green light usually means the modem is getting power. Now, let's check the other lights. Can you tell me what the other lights are doing?

messages.label: User
messages.text: Ugh, okay. There's another light with two arrows, one pointing up and one pointing down. It's just blinking. Is that what it's supposed to do? This is taking forever.

messages.label: User
messages.text:
I understand this is frustrating, and I appreciate your patience. That blinking light means the modem is struggling to connect. Let's try a quick restart, which usually fixes this.

First, please unplug the power cord from the back of your modem.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Alright, I've unplugged the power cord from the back of the modem.

messages.label: User
messages.text: Okay, I've unplugged the power cord from the modem.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Great!!Now, let's wait for about 30 seconds before plugging it back in. This gives the modem a chance to reset. After 30 seconds, please plug the power cord back into the modem.

messages.label: plug_in_device_power
User
messages.text:
That's great news! A steady green light means the modem is back online.

Now, please try to browse to a website on one of your devices to see if the internet is working again.
